attributes.name: Vellexia
attributes.powers:
Vellexia is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. Before you act, if there are other open locations, Vellexia is undefeated; otherwise, any number of other characters at your location may also summon and encounter her.

If undefeated, Vellexia deals you 1d20 Mental damage that may not be reduced.

If Vellexia would be defeated, she is evaded instead; display the loot Blessing of Nocticula from the box next to your location.
